text:
leo: dropping a quick thread from the design huddle — re: autoscale panel copy + small UX tweaks I prototyped.
michelle: saw the mock, nice. my big worry: users confuse 'burst' with 'burst pool' we've used elsewhere. can we use 'Burst capacity' everywhere?
jahid: +1. also can we show a small inline example: 'If min=2 and burst=4, peak capacity=6' — helps non-technical folks.
leo: added that example in-line under the fields. used monospace for clarity: `min=2, burst=4 -> peak=6`.
ken: accessibility check: the inline example uses code style with low contrast on dark mode. make sure code bg meets AA. Also, keyboard: Shift+Tab should go back to the pool select. Right now it jumps oddly.
anya: noted on keyboard. I'll audit focus order. For copy, how about changing badge from 'Guaranteed' to 'Reserved (billed)' so finance folks get it.
michelle: 'Reserved (billed)' is great, but maybe tooltip: 'Reserved capacity is billed even if unused.' Keep it blunt.
jahid: validation idea: if user sets max < min, show this UI flow:
```
inline error: "Max must be >= Min (we recommend setting Max >= 2x Min)."
primary action: "Fix automatically" -> sets Max = 2 * Min
secondary action: "Edit manually"
```
leo: I like the one-click fix pattern. reduces friction during onboarding.
ken: SLO slider: can we label the metric more plainly? use 'Latency (median)' and show p50 in parenthesis. Screen readers will read 'Latency median, slider' — we should include aria-label="Latency (median) slider".
michelle: what about defaulting pool selection to 'Recommended for you' instead of alphabetical? We can show a tiny tag: 'Recommended - same region, lower latency'.
anya: recommended pool plus a tooltip that says why it's recommended (region, cost, recent usage). keeps trust.
jahid: mobile note: collapse helper copy under a chevron. otherwise the wizard overflows.
leo: good call — helpers inline on desktop, collapsed on mobile. I'll add breakpoints in the spec.
ken: one more a11y: ensure slider has value labels visible and updated with `aria-live` when changed. Some assistive tech won't announce it otherwise.
michelle: burst confirm modal needs cost delta shown upfront: 'Estimated hourly change: +$0.35' and a tiny link 'How we calculate this'.
leo: will implement collapsed details by default and a 'Why this cost?' link that opens an overlay.
prod-bot: Reminder set: autoscale-copy-review @ 1794287500 (Friday 9:05) — react with :white_check_mark: if you can make it.
anya: I'll be there, will bring the keyboard flow checklist.
jahid: I'll run a quick heuristic test against the prototype once it's up.
leo: timeline: I'll push updated Figma + prototype by Wednesday EOD. please add any remaining tiny copy asks as comments on the frame.
michelle: thanks — small but important fixes, love the example addition.
ken: thanks team, will audit contrast and aria after the next build.
leo: thanks all, closing thread.
